ideas.title: How to take your tablet, from its leaflet
ideas.body: When you log a GLP-1 tablet, GLPMGR shows how to take it, in the words of its patient leaflet, with a link to the full leaflet. For semaglutide and orforglipron tablets where GLPMGR has checked the leaflet for your region.

ideas.title: A countdown after tablets that need a wait
ideas.body: If your tablet's leaflet says to wait 30 minutes before eating, drinking or taking other medicines, Today counts it down and can remind you when the wait is over. You can turn the reminder off in Settings › Reminders.

ideas.title: Search or scan a food for its protein
ideas.body: The Protein tile's new Search or Scan a Food brings every way to add protein together. Search thousands of foods from the UK, US, French and Australian food tables (your own country's first), pick from your recent foods, scan a barcode or the nutrition label, then choose how much you had and check the protein before it's added. Search is on your device; a barcode scan sends only the barcode number to Open Food Facts to look the product up. Premium, with protein tracking.

ideas.title: Log a meal's protein from a photo or by voice
ideas.body: On iPhones with Apple Intelligence (iOS 27), take a photo of your meal or say what you had. Apple's on-device model names the foods, the protein comes from the food tables, never a guess, and you check everything before it's added. Nothing leaves your phone. Premium, with protein tracking.

ideas.title: Body map help when your medicine has no brand chosen
ideas.body: If you record a medicine by its ingredient alone (for example "Semaglutide"), where the brands' leaflets differ, GLPMGR now says which brand to choose so it can show that medicine's injection areas and body map.

ideas.title: Smarter dose reminders
ideas.body: Choose an optional heads-up before a dose is due (from 30 minutes to the day before) and a follow-up if it isn't logged yet. Dose reminders gain Log Dose and Snooze buttons, with a snooze time you pick, and can come through a Focus if you turn on Time Sensitive. All in Settings › Reminders, and all off until you turn them on.

ideas.title: A side-effect check-in after each dose
ideas.body: An optional "How are you feeling?" reminder a set time after each dose (4 hours to 2 days), which opens the symptom log. A quick record of side effects helps you spot patterns and is ready for your next appointment.

ideas.title: An evening protein reminder
ideas.body: An optional nudge at a time you choose, only on days you're still under your protein goal. It stops for the day as soon as you reach it. Premium, with protein tracking.

ideas.title: Weekly weigh-in reminder for everyone
ideas.body: The weekly weigh-in reminder, at the day and time you pick, no longer needs Maintenance tools switched on. It never mentions your weight.

ideas.title: All your reminders in one place
ideas.body: A new Settings › Reminders page lists every reminder GLPMGR offers (doses, supply, tablets, side-effect check-ins, water, protein, weigh-ins and backups), each with its own switch and times.

ideas.title: Dose alarm on Apple Watch
ideas.body: When a dose is due, your Apple Watch taps your wrist (three taps every 30 seconds, or a pattern you choose) until you tap Taken or Snooze. Taken logs the dose on your iPhone. The alarm is set whenever GLPMGR is open on your Watch in the day and a half before a dose, and your Watch asks for one tap to set it when a dose is coming up. Premium.

ideas.title: Answer reminders from the notification, on iPhone or Apple Watch
ideas.body: Reminders gain buttons so you can act without opening the app: Log a Glass on a water reminder, Add a Serving on a protein reminder, Log Weight on the weigh-in, and Log Dose and Snooze on a dose reminder. They work on your iPhone and on your Apple Watch. On the Watch, Log Dose records the dose on your iPhone straight away; you can add the injection site there later.

ideas.title: Swipe between screens on Apple Watch
ideas.body: The Watch app now has one screen for each thing, swiped left and right: your next dose (and whether its alarm is set), your weight with Log Weight, water, and protein. No more scrolling up and down.

ideas.title: Changing medicine, checked and tracked
ideas.body: When you record a dose of a different GLP-1 medicine, brand, or form (injection or tablet), GLPMGR checks it's the one you meant, shows what that medicine's product information says about using two GLP-1 medicines together, and offers to pause the old medicine's reminders so you're not reminded about both. Every change is marked on your timeline, your Journey chart, Trends and the report for your doctor.

ideas.title: Dose steps and missed-dose guides for each medicine
ideas.body: See how your medicine's dose steps up, and what to do if you miss a dose, in the words of its own UK leaflet or US prescribing information, with the source and when GLPMGR checked it. Open it from the Next Dose tile, your dosing schedule, or when you record a dose. Your prescriber's instructions always come first.
